bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
docker inspect "$cid" --format 'config={{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}} work={{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.working_dir"}} image={{.Config.Image}}'
docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{println .Destination .Type}}{{end}}'
docker exec "$cid" sh -c 'test -f /opt/videobot/src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs; test -f /opt/videobot/src/telegram/paidMedia.mjs; node -v'
